home.title: An order is a plan. A fill changes the next decision.
home.intro: Follow one idea from a target position to an actual account. Eight small experiments show where fills, costs and uncertainty change the result.
home.technical: Installation, API details and original reference
flow.question: Where do the money and shares go?
flow.summary: Step through a buy and a sell. Watch cash, shares and fees move together.
book.question: Why did only part of the order fill?
book.summary: A visible price is not unlimited stock. Separate the fill from the later report.
cost.question: Which costs have already been paid?
cost.summary: Separate cash fees, the price you traded at, and the opportunity you missed.
impact.question: Can one trade make the next trade more expensive?
impact.summary: Compare a temporary displacement with an assumed persistent one.
lots.question: Why is the best-looking portfolio not always feasible?
lots.summary: Whole lots, available cash and minimum fees change which choices are possible.
paths.question: What changes when the same idea meets a different market?
paths.summary: Compare separate accounts. Different scenarios do not automatically come with probabilities.
selection.question: Did we find a good strategy, or a lucky result?
selection.summary: Keep all six trials in view, including the ones that were not selected.
risk.question: Did the risk forecast match what happened?
risk.summary: Compare a prediction with its matching outcome, and keep missing outcomes visible.
